This man names a result where the removal of a countable set from the two- sphere results in three congruent subsets A, B, and C that are also congruent to B union C, this man's paradox. Llanes-Estrada, Cotanch, General, and Wang created an analogue of this statement in the momentum distribution of heavy-quark hadron decays, and a convenient visualization for this statement is the "parabola" named for its second namesake. This operation is related to the autocorrelation function by the Wiener- Khinchin theorem, and its "fractional" extension is used as a noise filter and allows this operation to be applied a non-integer number of times. This substance is modified to form diphthamide, which is found in eukaryotic elongation factor 2 and is ADP-ribosylated by the diphtheria toxin. Name these small objects sometimes described as "failed stars."

The one dimensional cutting stock problem is a special case of it and Applegate and Bixby designed the CONCORDE program to solve it.
